ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.2 white-to-black pixel intensity ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white patches located on distal lobe sections; Left lobe features a white distal-outer quadrant with inward black mottling; Right lobe features a white distal-medial field (approx 50% lobe area) containing five distinct, low-intensity circular blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; vertex angle approximately 55 degrees; base partially obscured by water turbulence pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; peak amplitude is most pronounced on the distal-lateral margins; average peak-to-peak interval approx 10-20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex bilateral sweep from the peduncle base towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-intensity, roughly circular nodes (barnacle colonies) on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe; smaller cluster visible on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel, low-intensity diagonal lines (rake marks) breaking the white pigmentation on the right lobe's medial-distal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized calcified clusters (barnacles) on both lobe tips; distinct black circular scars/pigmentation within the white field of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'polka-dot' pigmentation pattern consisting of isolated black circles on the otherwise high-intensity white field of the right lobe.
